brief.title: Leave & Attendance System for Plant Workforce
business_goals: Move attendance and leave management onto one unified system
Automatically pull punch-in and punch-out data from existing biometric fingerprint scanners
Enable workers to apply for leave from a mobile app
Ensure shift supervisors approve or reject leave requests within 24 hours
Automatically escalate unapproved leave requests to HR after 24 hours
Lock and export leave and attendance data by the 25th of each month for payroll
Accurately track earned leave accrual for factory workers as per Factories Act (1 day for every 20 days worked)
Provide supervisors with a shift-wise attendance dashboard to identify absences proactively
Automate the flow of attendance and leave data into GreytHR for payroll processing
Flag overtime (punch-out > 30 mins after shift end) for manager approval
Retain at least two years of attendance history for labour audits
Ensure attendance status updates within 5 minutes of a punch
Maintain a simple attendance log for contract workers for compliance reporting

stakeholders.name: Sunita Rao
concerns: Unifying attendance and leave systems for 460 workers
Mobile app for leave applications and supervisor approval workflow
Retention of 2 years of attendance history for audits
Budget constraints (under 8 lakh rupees for first year)

stakeholders.name: Vikram Singh
concerns: Automated data pull from existing biometric scanners (not replacing hardware)
Compliance with Factories Act for earned leave accrual
Excluding shift scheduling from current scope

stakeholders.name: Deepak Joshi
concerns: Ensuring leave and attendance data is locked and exported by the 25th
Preventing late changes to attendance records
Accurate flagging and approval of overtime
Eliminating chaos from current WhatsApp leave process

stakeholders.name: Anjali Mehta
concerns: Automated integration with GreytHR for payroll
System performance and scalability for 460 users (5-minute attendance status updates)
Technical requirements for biometric scanner integration

constraints: Must integrate with existing biometric fingerprint scanners (hardware not to be replaced)
Leave and attendance data must be locked and exported by the 25th of each month
Must comply with Factories Act for earned leave accrual (1 day for every 20 days worked)
Must integrate with GreytHR for payroll processing (ideally automated export)
Must retain at least two years of attendance history for labour audits
Attendance status updates must occur within 5 minutes of a punch
Budget limit of 8 lakh rupees for the first year (including licensing)
System must be live before the next audit cycle in April
open_questions: What are the specific technical details (e.g., API, data format) for integrating with the existing biometric fingerprint scanners?
What are the exact integration capabilities and preferred method for automated export to GreytHR?
What is the precise date of the 'next audit cycle in April'?
What are the specific requirements for the 'simple log for compliance reporting' for contract workers?
Are there any other specific leave types beyond casual, sick, and earned leave that need to be configured?
How will manual attendance adjustments or exceptions be handled within the system?

requirements.statement: The system shall unify attendance and leave management.
requirements.rationale: To move current paper registers and WhatsApp leave requests onto one system.
requirements.evidence: We need this to move onto one system.

requirements.statement: The system shall automatically pull punch-in and punch-out data from existing biometric fingerprint scanners.
requirements.rationale: To leverage existing hardware and automate data collection.
requirements.evidence: Whatever we build needs to pull punch-in and punch-out data from those scanners automatically — we are not replacing the hardware.

requirements.statement: The system shall enable workers to apply for leave from a mobile application.
requirements.rationale: To streamline the leave application process and eliminate the current WhatsApp chaos.
requirements.evidence: Workers should be able to apply for leave from a mobile app

requirements.statement: The system shall enable shift supervisors to approve or reject leave requests.
requirements.rationale: To formalize the leave approval workflow.
requirements.evidence: their shift supervisor must approve or reject it within 24 hours.

requirements.statement: The system shall automatically escalate unapproved leave requests to HR if a supervisor does not respond within 24 hours.
requirements.rationale: To ensure timely processing of leave requests and prevent delays.
requirements.evidence: If the supervisor doesn't respond, it should escalate to the HR desk automatically.

requirements.statement: The system shall lock leave and attendance data by the 25th of each month.
requirements.rationale: To prevent late changes that cause payroll problems.
requirements.evidence: leave and attendance data has to be locked and exported by the 25th.

requirements.statement: The system shall export leave and attendance data by the 25th of each month.
requirements.rationale: To provide timely data for payroll processing.
requirements.evidence: leave and attendance data has to be locked and exported by the 25th.

requirements.statement: The system shall prevent changes to attendance records after data has been locked for payroll processing.
requirements.rationale: To avoid issues like redoing payroll due to late changes.
requirements.evidence: Late changes have caused us real problems — last March we had to redo payroll for 40 workers because someone changed an attendance record after the export.

requirements.statement: The system shall accurately track earned leave accrual for factory workers as per the Factories Act (1 day for every 20 days worked).
requirements.rationale: To ensure compliance with the Factories Act.
requirements.evidence: the Factories Act requires we track earned leave accrual at one day for every 20 days worked. That calculation has to be built in, it's a compliance thing, we can't get that wrong.

requirements.statement: The system should provide supervisors with a shift-wise attendance dashboard.
requirements.rationale: To enable supervisors to proactively identify absences before a shift starts.
requirements.evidence: Ideally supervisors should also be able to see a shift-wise attendance dashboard, so they know who's absent before the shift starts, not after.

requirements.statement: The system shall integrate with GreytHR for payroll processing.
requirements.rationale: To ensure attendance and leave data flows into the existing payroll system.
requirements.evidence: The attendance and leave data needs to flow into GreytHR before the payroll run — ideally through an automated export, not a manual file upload every month.

requirements.statement: The system should automate the export of attendance and leave data to GreytHR.
requirements.rationale: To avoid manual file uploads and streamline the payroll process.
requirements.evidence: The attendance and leave data needs to flow into GreytHR before the payroll run — ideally through an automated export, not a manual file upload every month.

requirements.statement: The system shall flag overtime (punch-out more than 30 minutes after shift end) for manager approval.
requirements.rationale: To accurately track and approve overtime for payroll at 1.5x rate.
requirements.evidence: Anyone who punches out more than 30 minutes after their shift end should have that overtime flagged for manager approval, since we pay overtime at 1.5x.

requirements.statement: The system will not include shift scheduling or roster planning functionality.
requirements.rationale: This functionality is explicitly out of scope for the current initiative.
requirements.evidence: One thing that's explicitly out of scope right now — we are not doing shift scheduling or roster planning in this system.

requirements.statement: The system shall retain at least two years of attendance history.
requirements.rationale: To meet requirements for labour audits.
requirements.evidence: We need at least two years of attendance history retained for labour audits — the last labour inspection asked for two years of records and we scrambled to pull it together from paper files.

requirements.statement: The system shall update attendance status within 5 minutes of a punch.
requirements.rationale: To ensure system performance and real-time visibility for 460 users.
requirements.evidence: From a technical side, the system needs to handle punch data for all 460 people syncing every few minutes without lag — let's say attendance status should update within 5 minutes of a punch.

requirements.statement: The system implementation cost shall not exceed 8 lakh rupees for the first year, including licensing.
requirements.rationale: To adhere to budget constraints.
requirements.evidence: Budget-wise we've been told to keep this under 8 lakh rupees for the first year including any licensing

requirements.statement: The system shall be live before the next audit cycle in April.
requirements.rationale: To meet critical project timeline and compliance deadlines.
requirements.evidence: it needs to be live before the next audit cycle in April.

requirements.statement: The system shall maintain a simple attendance log for contract workers.
requirements.rationale: To fulfill compliance reporting requirements for contract workers.
requirements.evidence: just a simple log for compliance reporting.

requirements.statement: The system shall not feed contract worker attendance data into the payroll system.
requirements.rationale: Contract workers are managed by contractors, and their attendance is not relevant for internal payroll.
requirements.evidence: their attendance doesn't need to feed into our payroll system

epics.title: Core Attendance Tracking
epics.goal: To accurately and efficiently capture and manage worker attendance data from biometric sources, including overtime and historical records, for all worker types.

epics.title: Leave Management Workflow
epics.goal: To provide a seamless and automated process for workers to apply for leave and for supervisors to manage these requests, ensuring compliance and timely resolution.

epics.title: Payroll Integration & Data Management
epics.goal: To ensure accurate and timely preparation of attendance and leave data for payroll processing, maintaining data integrity and compliance.

epics.title: Supervisor Insights & Reporting
epics.goal: To empower shift supervisors with real-time attendance visibility to proactively manage their teams.

stories.title: Automatic Biometric Punch Data Capture
stories.i_want: to automatically pull punch-in and punch-out data from biometric scanners
stories.so_that: worker attendance records are accurately captured without manual intervention and updated promptly

acceptance_criteria.given: biometric scanners record a punch
acceptance_criteria.then: the system retrieves the punch data within 5 minutes

acceptance_criteria.given: the system retrieves punch data
acceptance_criteria.then: the punch time and worker ID are stored in the attendance log

stories.title: Overtime Flagging for Manager Approval
stories.i_want: the system to flag overtime for my approval
stories.so_that: I can review and authorize extra hours worked by my team

acceptance_criteria.given: a worker punches out more than 30 minutes after their scheduled shift end
acceptance_criteria.then: the attendance record displays 'Overtime Pending Approval' for the excess time

acceptance_criteria.given: an overtime flag is present
acceptance_criteria.then: I can see the flagged overtime and approve or reject it

stories.title: Contract Worker Attendance Log
stories.i_want: the system to maintain a simple attendance log for contract workers
stories.so_that: we can ensure compliance reporting without impacting payroll

acceptance_criteria.given: a contract worker punches in/out
acceptance_criteria.then: their punch data is stored in a separate contract worker attendance log

acceptance_criteria.given: contract worker attendance data is recorded
acceptance_criteria.then: contract worker attendance data is excluded from the payroll feed

stories.title: Attendance History Retention
stories.i_want: the system to retain at least two years of attendance history
stories.so_that: we can comply with labour audit requirements

acceptance_criteria.given: attendance data is stored
acceptance_criteria.then: the system can provide attendance records for any worker for the past 24 months

acceptance_criteria.given: attendance data older than 24 months exists
acceptance_criteria.when: the system performs data retention tasks
acceptance_criteria.then: data older than 24 months is archived or purged according to policy

stories.title: Mobile Leave Application for Workers
stories.i_want: to apply for leave using a mobile application
stories.so_that: I can easily submit my leave requests from anywhere and manage my time off

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged into the mobile app
acceptance_criteria.when: I select "Apply for Leave" and fill in the required details (type, dates, reason)
acceptance_criteria.then: my leave request is submitted for approval

acceptance_criteria.given: I have submitted a leave request
acceptance_criteria.when: I view my leave history in the app
acceptance_criteria.then: my pending leave request is displayed with its current status

stories.title: Supervisor Leave Request Approval/Rejection
stories.i_want: to approve or reject leave requests submitted by my team
stories.so_that: I can manage my team's availability and ensure operational continuity

acceptance_criteria.given: a worker submits a leave request
acceptance_criteria.when: I access the pending leave requests
acceptance_criteria.then: I can see the details of the request and choose to "Approve" or "Reject"

acceptance_criteria.given: I approve a leave request
acceptance_criteria.then: the worker is notified of the approval and their leave balance is updated

acceptance_criteria.given: I reject a leave request
acceptance_criteria.then: the worker is notified of the rejection with the reason provided

stories.title: Automatic Leave Request Escalation to HR
stories.i_want: unapproved leave requests to automatically escalate to HR after 24 hours
stories.so_that: no leave request is left unaddressed and workers receive timely responses

acceptance_criteria.given: a leave request is submitted to a supervisor
acceptance_criteria.when: 24 hours pass without a supervisor's decision
acceptance_criteria.then: the leave request's status is updated to 'Escalated to HR' and assigned to the HR Administrator role

acceptance_criteria.given: a leave request is escalated to HR
acceptance_criteria.when: an HR Administrator views pending leave requests
acceptance_criteria.then: the escalated request is clearly visible for HR action

stories.title: Calculate Earned Leave Accrual
stories.i_want: the system to accurately calculate earned leave accrual for factory workers
stories.so_that: we comply with the Factories Act and workers receive their rightful leave entitlements

acceptance_criteria.given: a factory worker completes 20 days of work as defined by system rules
acceptance_criteria.then: their earned leave balance increases by 1 day

acceptance_criteria.given: a worker's attendance record is updated for a working day
acceptance_criteria.then: the worker's earned leave balance is updated to reflect the latest working days

stories.notes: This story focuses on the calculation logic. Display of the balance is covered in S-021.

stories.title: Monthly Data Lock for Payroll
stories.i_want: to lock leave and attendance data by the 25th of each month
stories.so_that: payroll processing can begin with final, unchangeable data

acceptance_criteria.given: it is the 25th of the month
acceptance_criteria.when: I initiate the data lock process
acceptance_criteria.then: all attendance and leave records for the preceding period are marked as locked

acceptance_criteria.given: data is locked for a specific period
acceptance_criteria.when: a user attempts to modify an attendance or leave record within that period
acceptance_criteria.then: the system prevents the modification and displays an error message

stories.title: Monthly Data Export for Payroll
stories.i_want: to export leave and attendance data by the 25th of each month
stories.so_that: I can transfer it to the payroll system for timely salary processing

acceptance_criteria.given: attendance and leave data is locked for the month
acceptance_criteria.then: a file containing all relevant data for the payroll period is generated

acceptance_criteria.given: the export file is generated
acceptance_criteria.then: it contains accurate attendance days, leave days, and overtime hours for each employee

stories.title: Establish GreytHR Integration Connectivity
stories.i_want: the system to establish secure connectivity with GreytHR
stories.so_that: attendance and leave data can be reliably exchanged for payroll processing

acceptance_criteria.given: GreytHR API credentials are configured in the system
acceptance_criteria.when: the system attempts to connect to GreytHR
acceptance_criteria.then: a successful connection status is reported in the system's integration log

acceptance_criteria.given: the system is configured for GreytHR integration
acceptance_criteria.when: a test data transfer is initiated
acceptance_criteria.then: the system logs a successful authentication and authorization event with GreytHR

stories.notes: This story covers the foundational connectivity. Data transfer for specific types (attendance, leave) is covered in separate stories.

stories.title: Shift-wise Attendance Dashboard for Supervisors
stories.so_that: I can quickly identify absences and manage my team's presence proactively

acceptance_criteria.given: I log into the system
acceptance_criteria.then: I see a list of my team members grouped by their assigned shift

acceptance_criteria.given: I view the dashboard during a shift
acceptance_criteria.when: I look at a team member's status
acceptance_criteria.then: I can see their current attendance status (e.g., Present, Absent, On Leave)

acceptance_criteria.given: an employee is marked absent
acceptance_criteria.then: their absence is highlighted for immediate attention

issues: The story does not specify the trigger or schedule for when the earned leave accrual calculation should run (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly, on punch-out).
reviews.fix_instructions: Update the acceptance criteria to include when the system performs the accrual calculation, for example: 'When a worker's attendance record for a month is finalized, their earned leave balance is updated based on days worked.'

issues: AC2.then has no observable outcome verb

gaps.description: The business goal to "Automate the flow of attendance and leave data into GreytHR for payroll processing" (Goal 9) and requirement R-012 ("The system should automate the export...") are not fully covered by backlog item S-011, which only addresses "Establish GreytHR Integration Connectivity" (R-011).
gaps.suggested_question: S-011 covers connectivity, but how will the *automation* of data export to GreytHR (as per Goal 9 and R-012) be implemented and ensured?

gaps.description: Requirement R-017, stating the system implementation cost shall not exceed 8 lakh rupees for the first year, is not addressed by any backlog item.
gaps.suggested_question: How will the project ensure the implementation cost, including licensing, remains within the 8 lakh rupee budget for the first year, as specified in R-017?

gaps.description: Requirement R-018, mandating the system be live before the next audit cycle in April, is not addressed by any backlog item.
gaps.suggested_question: What is the plan to ensure the system is live before the next audit cycle in April, as required by R-018?

gaps.description: Open question regarding specific technical details (API, data format) for integrating with existing biometric fingerprint scanners (R-002, S-001) remains unanswered.
gaps.suggested_question: What are the specific technical details (e.g., API, data format, communication protocol) required for integrating with the existing biometric fingerprint scanners?

gaps.description: Open question regarding exact integration capabilities and preferred method for automated export to GreytHR (Goal 9, R-011, R-012, S-011) needs clarification.
gaps.suggested_question: Beyond establishing connectivity, what are the exact integration capabilities and the preferred method for automated export of data to GreytHR?

gaps.description: The precise date of the 'next audit cycle in April' (R-018) is not specified, which is crucial for the go-live deadline.
gaps.suggested_question: What is the precise date of the 'next audit cycle in April' to confirm the exact go-live deadline?

gaps.description: The specific requirements for the 'simple log for compliance reporting' for contract workers (R-019, S-003) are not detailed.
gaps.suggested_question: What specific information needs to be captured and reported in the 'simple attendance log' for contract workers to meet compliance reporting needs?

gaps.description: It's unclear if there are other specific leave types beyond casual, sick, and earned leave that need to be configured in the system.
gaps.suggested_question: Are there any other specific leave types, besides casual, sick, and earned leave, that need to be configured and managed within the new system?

gaps.description: The process for handling manual attendance adjustments or exceptions within the system is not defined.
gaps.suggested_question: What is the process for handling manual attendance adjustments or exceptions, and how should the system support this?

gaps.coverage_note: The backlog covers most core functional requirements for leave and attendance management, including biometric integration, mobile leave applications, supervisor approvals, earned leave accrual, and basic payroll data handling. However, critical non-functional requirements regarding budget and the precise go-live date for the April audit are not addressed in the backlog. Additionally, while GreytHR integration is planned, the explicit automation of data export, a key business goal, lacks specific backlog coverage. Several technical and operational details, such as exact integration methods and handling of manual attendance adjustments, remain ambiguous and require further clarification.
